title: Apply De Morgan’s laws.
summary: De Morgan’s laws allow negated boolean expressions to be rewritten by exchanging && and || and negating their operands. For example, !(a && b) can be written as !a || !b. It is in Staticcheck since 2021.1. It is in the quickfix group of checks.

title: Convert untagged switch to tagged switch.
summary: An untagged switch that compares a single variable against a series of values can be replaced with a tagged switch. It is in Staticcheck since 2021.1. It is in the quickfix group of checks.

title: Convert if/else-if chain to tagged switch.
summary: A series of if/else-if checks comparing the same variable against values can be replaced with a tagged switch. It is in Staticcheck since 2021.1. It is in the quickfix group of checks.

title: Use strings.ReplaceAll instead of strings.Replace with n == -1.
summary: The strings and bytes packages provide functions for replacing or splitting all occurrences without an explicit count. Calls to Replace with a count of -1 can use ReplaceAll instead; similarly, SplitN and SplitAfterN can use Split and SplitAfter. It is in Staticcheck since 2021.1. It is in the quickfix group of checks.

title: Expand call to math.Pow.
summary: Some uses of math.Pow can be simplified to basic multiplication. It is in Staticcheck since 2021.1. It is in the quickfix group of checks.

title: Lift if+break into loop condition.
summary: An unconditional loop that begins with an if statement whose only action is to break can instead use the negated condition as its loop condition. This makes the loop’s termination condition visible in the loop header and removes a level of nesting. It is in Staticcheck since 2021.1. It is in the quickfix group of checks.

title: Merge conditional assignment into variable declaration.
summary: A boolean variable initialized to false and immediately set to true under a condition can be initialized with that condition directly. The reverse pattern, starting with true and conditionally setting false, can use the negated condition. It is in Staticcheck since 2021.1. It is in the quickfix group of checks.

title: Omit embedded fields from selector expression.
summary: Go promotes the fields and methods of embedded fields to the containing struct. When this allows the same field or method to be accessed directly, the explicit embedded field can be omitted to make selectors less verbose. It is in Staticcheck since 2021.1. It is in the quickfix group of checks.

title: Use time.Time.Equal instead of == operator.
summary: Comparing time.Time values with == compares all their fields, including their locations and monotonic clock readings. Two values can therefore represent the same instant yet compare unequal. It is in Staticcheck since 2021.1. It is in the quickfix group of checks.

title: Convert slice of bytes to string when printing it.
summary: Functions such as fmt.Println and log.Print print a []byte as a list of numeric byte values. If the slice contains text and the intent is to print that text, converting the slice to a string produces the desired output. It is in Staticcheck since 2021.1. It is in the quickfix group of checks.

title: Omit redundant type from variable declaration.
summary: A local variable’s type can be inferred from its initial value. When this inferred type is identical to the explicitly declared type, the explicit type can be omitted to make the declaration shorter without changing its meaning. It is in Staticcheck since 2021.1. It is in the quickfix group of checks.

title: Use fmt.Fprintf(x, ...) instead of x.Write(fmt.Sprintf(...)).
summary: When writing formatted output to an io.Writer, fmt.Fprint, fmt.Fprintf, and fmt.Fprintln can format and write in one call. This is more direct than passing the result of fmt.Sprint, fmt.Sprintf, or fmt.Sprintln to WriteString or converting it to []byte for Write, and avoids constructing an intermediate string. It is in Staticcheck since 2022.1. It is in the quickfix group of checks.
